lines.zh: 轰隆隆，天空中响起了惊雷！
lines.en: Thunder rumbles in the sky!

lines.zh: 太阳风暴来了，别靠近我！
lines.en: Sunstorm coming, stay back!

lines.zh: 闪电缠绕，我是太阳风暴！
lines.en: Lightning wrapped, I am Sunstorm!
Sun's wrath, none can stand!
I consume light and heat!
Light elements gather here!
In the storm, I am a dragon!
Sky's fury, about to erupt!
I bring destruction and light!
Highest in the sky, I am here!
I wait for my prey!
Observing, waiting for chance!
Thunder clouds lower, I am ready!
Light flickers, waiting patiently!
Waiting, prey is about to appear!
Rolling thunder, I am here!
In the sky, my voice is loudest!
Silent, waiting for prey!
King of the storm!
I, the Sky's King!
The thunderclouds churn while I sharpen my claws.
My column of smoke circles me slowly!
This cloud of smoke is gathering!

lines.zh: 火光在我脚下舔着地面！
lines.en: Flames lick the ground beneath my feet!
I count the thunder like a heartbeat!

lines.zh: 太阳在我背后烧得正旺！
lines.en: The sun burns hot behind my back!
Found you, prey!
Run, or you'll be set aflame!
Your presence, awakens me!
Targeting you, one shot kills!

lines.zh: 我的光芒，让你无处可逃！
lines.en: My light, no escape for you!
Saw you, preparing to attack!
Player, my target!
You move, I strike!
Prey moves, attack!

lines.zh: 你脚边的烟圈开始收拢。
lines.en: The smoke rings at your feet begin to close.
You are standing inside my smoke!
Don't turn your back. I'm right above you!

lines.zh: 太阳风暴摇摇欲坠，你能否撑过风暴？
lines.en: Sunstorm摇摇欲坠，can you survive the storm?

lines.zh: 你的盾牌挡不住太阳风暴的攻击！
lines.en: Your shield can't block Sunstorm's attack!

lines.zh: 太阳风暴的强大让你措手不及！
lines.en: Sunstorm's power catches you off guard!

lines.zh: 太阳风暴的攻击让你措手不及！
lines.en: Sunstorm's attack catches you off guard!

lines.zh: 太阳风暴的火焰让你难以招架！
lines.en: Sunstorm's flames can't be withstood!
Did you block the Sunstorm?

lines.zh: 太阳风暴的冲击让你摇摇欲坠！
lines.en: Sunstorm's shock makes you wobble!

lines.zh: 太阳风暴的怒火让你摇摇欲坠！
lines.en: Sunstorm's rage makes you wobble!

lines.zh: 你还能撑住太阳风暴吗？
lines.en: Can you endure the Sunstorm?
A corner of my light has been dimmed!

lines.zh: 你那块蛋糕真香，我得吃点！
lines.en: That cake smells good. I need a bite!

lines.zh: 这片森林里有很多美味的东西！
lines.en: There's plenty of tasty stuff in this forest!

lines.zh: 你带着的食物肯定很好吃！
lines.en: You must have some delicious food with you!

lines.zh: 看看这个，味道肯定不错！
lines.en: Try this. It must taste good!

lines.zh: 这附近肯定有好吃的东西，走吧！
lines.en: There must be something to eat nearby, let's go!

lines.zh: 森林深处，我一定能找到美味！
lines.en: In the forest, I'll find something delicious!
Eat it to make me stronger!

lines.zh: 我需要补充能量，吃掉它们！
lines.en: I need to eat to regain energy!

lines.zh: 森林里的食物非常丰富，来吃吧！
lines.en: The forest has plenty of food, come eat!
Don't run, I need to eat you!

lines.zh: 你挡了我的路，我得干掉你！
lines.en: You're blocking my path, I have to get rid of you!

lines.zh: 你离我太近了，我得攻击你！
lines.en: You're too close, I need to attack!

lines.zh: 你挡了我的去路，我只能攻击你！
lines.en: You're blocking my way, I must attack you!

lines.zh: 我得穿过你，否则我过不去！
lines.en: I need to go through you, or I can't pass!

lines.zh: 你挡了我的路，我必须解决你！
lines.en: You're in my way, I need to deal with you!

lines.zh: 你离我太近了，我不得不攻击你！
lines.en: You're too close, I have to attack you!

lines.zh: 你挡了我的路，我只能攻击！
lines.en: You're blocking my path, I must attack!

lines.zh: 必须清除你，我才能继续！
lines.en: I need to clear you to move on!

lines.zh: 你挡了我的去路，我只能攻击！
lines.en: You're blocking my path, I must attack!

lines.zh: 你离我太近了，我不得不攻击！
lines.en: You're too close, I have to attack!

lines.zh: 找到我的同类，一起战斗！
lines.en: Find my mate, fight together!

lines.zh: 我的同类在哪里？来吧，战斗！
lines.en: Where's my mate? Come, fight!

lines.zh: 找到我的同伴，共同作战！
lines.en: Find my companion, fight together!

lines.zh: 找一团够热的火，和我并排烧。
lines.en: Find a fire hot enough to burn beside me.

lines.zh: 找到我的同类，一起行动！
lines.en: Find my mate, let's act together!

lines.zh: 找到我的同类，共同作战！
lines.en: Find my mate, fight together!

lines.zh: 一起战斗，直到胜利！烟雾会一直移动。
lines.en: Fight together until we win! The smoke keeps moving.

lines.zh: 找到我的同类，共战到底！
lines.en: Find my mate, fight till the end!

lines.zh: 找个伙伴，一起烧穿天空！
lines.en: Find a partner and burn through the sky together!

lines.zh: 我的伴侣，要撑得住我的光！
lines.en: My mate must withstand my light!
My fiery breath surrounds you
I am the fury of the sun
Taste my scorching flames
The sun's light burns
Flame's狂热吞噬你burning consumes you

lines.zh: 我就是暴烈的太阳风暴
lines.en: I am the raging Sunstorm
Your fate lies in the flames
Burn, wretched traveler
Feel my solar wrath
You can only await destruction

lines.zh: 太阳底下，你的影子暴露了你。
lines.en: Under the sun, your shadow gives you away.
Your life will be mine

lines.zh: 烟雾追着你，跑到哪都烫。
lines.en: The smoke follows you; everywhere it touches burns.
The sun's light illuminates you
I come for your death
Your fate is about to end
I am your nightmare
You will be devoured by the sun
You cannot escape my grasp
I am the fury of the sun

lines.zh: 你的影子被我的光钉住了。
lines.en: My light has pinned your shadow down.
The smoke is drifting toward you.

lines.zh: 我的热气先到，我随后就到。
lines.en: My heat arrives first, then I do.
From the thunderhead, I fixed on you.

lines.zh: 烟雾圈起来了，你站在里面。
lines.en: The smoke has closed in, and you are inside it.

lines.zh: 别抬头，我就悬在你上面。
lines.en: Don't look up. I'm hanging right over you.
I have ringed you with this smoke.

lines.zh: 这一片焦土，只留你一个。
lines.en: This scorched ground is left for you alone.
Burn until death
Find release in the flames
I won't let you leave alive
Your fear will come true

lines.zh: 火焰中的末日即将到来
lines.en: The end of your days in the flames is coming
You can only howl in the flames
You will be reduced to ash
Feel the curse of the sun
You will be consumed by flames
Find your fate in the flames
The ring of smoke is closing at your feet.
Stand still. The fire is coming.
My smoke will burn your feet first.

lines.zh: 你跑不过这片移动的烟。
lines.en: You can't outrun this moving smoke.
The light comes first, the thunder follows.
I'm dropping low, ready to slam down.

lines.zh: 你身上的水分，正在蒸干。
lines.en: The water in you is boiling away.

lines.zh: 下一口气，你吸的就是火。
lines.en: Your next breath will be fire.
I have burned this path shut.
Count to three, and you burn.
Flames spread, burning all!
Pain spreads under the ashes!
Flame storm, burns all!
Flame spirit, burns itself!
Bake the land, none spared!
Flame flood, swallows all!
Fiery sky, source of destruction!
Burn the soul, endless pain!
Flame song, burns hope!
Fiery rage, nowhere to hide!
A wisp of smoke slips into your collar!
Lightning grazes across your back!
My heat wave knocks you over!
The flames have bitten your boots!
Sunstorm, descends upon the world!
Darkness, giant awakens!
Sky splits, storm descends!
Sky's rage, unbreakable!
Sky's rift, storm eye!
Sky torn, storm comes!
Sky's fury, swallows the world!
Sky's gash, storm source!
Above the wasteland, the clouds burn through!

lines.zh: 我从焦黑的裂缝里升起！
lines.en: I rise out of a scorched fissure!

lines.zh: 太阳落下的地方，我来了！
lines.en: Where the sun sets, I arrive!
Thunder rolls, and I land!
The hot wind comes first, then I descend!
When the horizon flares, that's me!
I burned a hole right through the clouds!
The sand starts to scorch. I'm here!
Fire spreads where I touch down!
I appear dragging a pillar of smoke!
In broad daylight, I suddenly appear!
The air starts to warp. I have come!
Burnt by Sunstorm!

lines.zh: 被太阳风暴的陨石砸中了！
lines.en: Struck by Sunstorm's meteor!

lines.zh: 太阳风暴的陨石砸中了你！
lines.en: Sunstorm's meteor hits you!

lines.zh: 被太阳风暴的陨石砸中了
lines.en: Struck by Sunstorm's meteor!

lines.zh: 被太阳风暴的陨石击中了！
lines.en: Hit by Sunstorm's meteor!

lines.zh: 被太阳风暴的魔法灼伤了！
lines.en: Burnt by Sunstorm's magic!

lines.zh: 营养不良让太阳风暴虚弱！
lines.en: Sunstorm weakened by starvation!

lines.zh: 被太阳风暴的雷电击中了！
lines.en: Struck by Sunstorm's lightning!

lines.zh: 掉入了太阳风暴的陨石坑！
lines.en: Fell into Sunstorm's crater!
